document: Form PENS.E/7-B - Payment Instructions for a Benefit (5 years or more of contributory service)

chunks.heading: What form PENS.E/7-B is used for
chunks.text: Form PENS.E/7-B elects a benefit option and provides payment instructions for a participant with 5 or more years of contributory service. Only ONE benefit option may be selected.

chunks.heading: Benefit option A: Normal retirement benefit (article 28)
chunks.text: Three sub-options: (1) full retirement benefit paid as a monthly benefit with no lump sum; (2) maximum lump sum with the balance paid as a monthly benefit; (3) a fixed lump-sum commutation (less than the maximum lump sum) with the balance paid as a monthly benefit - the requested fixed lump sum amount (A3) is entered in US dollars.

chunks.heading: Benefit option B: Early retirement benefit (article 29)
chunks.text: Mirrors option A's three sub-options for early retirement: full monthly benefit with no lump sum; maximum lump sum plus monthly balance; or a fixed lump-sum commutation (B3, in US dollars) plus monthly balance.

chunks.heading: Benefit option C: Deferred retirement benefit (article 30)
chunks.text: A single option to elect a deferred retirement benefit.

chunks.heading: Benefit option D: Withdrawal settlement (article 31)
chunks.text: A final cash withdrawal settlement, which extinguishes all other entitlements.

chunks.heading: Section 3: bank account for a monthly benefit
chunks.text: Applicable only if the participant elects a monthly benefit under option A or B - requires payee name, bank name, account number/IBAN, bank ID code, currency, account type, bank address, and intermediary bank details if applicable.

chunks.heading: Section 4/5: bank account for a lump sum or withdrawal settlement
chunks.text: Applicable only if the participant elects option D, or wants the lump sum under option A or B paid to a different account than the one used for the monthly benefit in Section 3.

chunks.heading: Section 5: emergency contact
chunks.text: For UNJSPF's use only when all efforts to reach the participant through normal channels fail.

chunks.heading: Documents required with form PENS.E/7-B
chunks.text: A valid government-issued photo ID showing full name, date of birth and scripted signature, and a recently dated bank statement/document (e.g. voided cheque) showing all banking information.

chunks.heading: Acknowledgements on form PENS.E/7-B
chunks.text: The participant confirms having read articles 28, 29, 30 and 31 of the UNJSPF Regulations and the form's instructions, and confirms enclosing the required photo ID and banking documentation.
